items.title: 73243_Joe Thomas oral history interview
items.q: which allowed us both to leave something for May and Willy so they could get home.

ctx.x: Yeah, or something like that. And he walked back the most to the bandstand surprised person in the world. So I said, let's strike up the band. Let's play a little 'St. Louis Blues.' So, anyhow, to make a long story short, after that we Eli wanted $150. Oh, yeah, we got it. Seventy-five for George, seventy-five for me, which allowed us both to leave something for May and Willy so they could get home. We didn't (...?)
